$comment: Facts about the meta figure that Unity needs, written by blender/meta/build_meta.py; do not edit. Lengths are metres. `unity` positions are in the avatar's frame as Unity imports it (x to its right, y up, z forward). The signature colour: every texel that is white in `atlas.tint` is painted in the hue `signature.hue` (0..1), at one of the strengths listed, and nothing else in the atlas is; turning the hue of those texels by (wanted - signature.hue) gives the wearer's colour. `atlas.emission` is white on the subset of them that glows. Each `sway` chain ends at `endUnity`, the far end of its last bone, which is what a physics chain of one bone needs to know to have anything to swing.

viewPosition.note: Inside the hood, where eyes would be.

fingerLight.note: The ends of the index fingers in the T-pose; the fingers point along the arm.
